thought.text: The 500 on /metrics is caused by the placeholder MONGODB_URI in .env.example. Since MongoDB is optional (per the guide), let's have .env.local omit the placeholder so that the app operates in the "no database" mode described in the documentation. First, let's check how the app handles the case when MONGODB_URI is not set.

reasoning_content:
The /metrics 500 error is caused by the placeholder value `MONGODB_URI=mongodb+srv://<BENUTZER>:<PASSWORT>@<CLUSTER>.mongodb.net/` in .env.local — the app is attempting to perform a DNS lookup on the placeholder. According to the docs, MongoDB is only required when using the metrics functionality, and the app should work without it when MONGODB_URI is not set. The placeholder is triggering the connection attempt. Let's clean up .env.local so that MONGODB_URI is unset (commented out), aligning with the docs' description of "funktioniert ohne Datenbank (works without a database)".

Actually — the docs say that MONGODB_URI is optional, and the app works without a database. The .env.example contains placeholder values. Best approach: comment out / delete the MONGODB_URI and MONGODB_DB lines in .env.local so that the app operates in the "without a database" mode that's documented. After that, /metrics might either display a degraded state or still fail, but that's the documented behavior when the DB is unavailable… Let me check how the app handles the case where MONGODB_URI is unset.

I'll take a quick look at the metrics code.

action.command: grep -rn "MONGODB_URI" /workspace/src --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" -l | head; echo ---; grep -rn "MONGODB_URI" /workspace/src/lib/mongodb*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; find /workspace/src -name "*.ts" -path "*mongo*" | head
